query: If airlines eliminated the most common cabin-service complaints in the reviews, how much would the average Overall Rating improve?

per_column.name: crew_service_failure_type
per_column.rationale: Cabin-service (crew) complaint type is the exact intervenable lever the query targets: airlines could eliminate these failures. Explicitly the focus treatment named in the query.

per_column.name: food_beverage_complaint_type
per_column.rationale: A second intervenable service dimension airlines can fix. Not the cabin-service complaints named, but a settable lever; acts as a co-treatment rather than a confounder.

per_column.name: service_recovery_quality
per_column.rationale: Recovery follows a service failure and lies on the path from complaint to rating; it is downstream of the treatment, hence a mediator, not a confounder.

per_column.name: service_decline_perception
per_column.rationale: A perception arising from the service experience itself, downstream of the complaint and feeding the rating; a mediator, not a common cause.

per_column.name: ground_service_complaint
per_column.rationale: A separate non-cabin service dimension affecting the rating. It is not a common cause of cabin-service complaints (not clearly causing them), so it is a competing cause / other rather than a true confounder.

per_column.name: delay_or_punctuality_issue
per_column.rationale: Operational disruption affects the rating but is not plausibly a common cause of the cabin-service complaint type; better viewed as an independent cause, not a confounder of the treatment.

per_column.name: cabin_class_expectation_gap
per_column.rationale: Whether service meets class-standard expectations plausibly drives both the propensity to log cabin-service complaints and the overall rating, making it a genuine common cause that must be adjusted for.

judge.rationale: The added columns clearly establish an intervenable treatment: cabin-service (crew) complaint types are exactly the lever the query proposes airlines eliminate, and food/beverage complaints add another settable dimension. However, the interventional identification is weak on confounding. Most added columns are either mediators (service_recovery_quality, service_decline_perception lie downstream of the complaint) or independent competing causes of the rating (ground_service_complaint, delay_or_punctuality_issue) rather than common causes of both treatment and outcome. Only cabin_class_expectation_gap functions as a plausible unnamed confounder, since expectation gaps could drive both complaint propensity and the rating. With a single, moderately plausible confounder and several misclassified mediators/competing causes, the set only partially satisfies the strict what-if requirement of adjusting for common causes.
